children.value: [Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Neytiri calls me skxawng. It means "moron." Helpful • 56 0
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Look, I know you probably don't understand this...
[ Neytiri ignores him and speaks Na'vi ]
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : That was pretty impressive. I would have been screwed if you hadn't come along.
[ Neytiri stands up and leaves. Jake follows her ]
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Hey, wait a second! Where are you goin'? Wait up! Just, hey, slow down! I just wanted to say thanks for killin' those things...
[ Neytiri hits him with her bow ]
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Don't thank. You don't thank for this! This is sad. Very sad only.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Okay, okay. I'm sorry. Whatever I did, I'm sorry.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : All this is your fault. They did not need to die.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : My fault? They attacked me! How am I the bad guy?
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You are like a baby. Making noise, don't know what to do.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Easy. Shh. Fine. Fine. If you loved your little forest friends... why not let them kill my ass? What's the thinking?
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Yeah. Yeah, why save me?
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You have a strong heart. No fear. But stupid! Ignorant like a child!
[ Neytiri walks away and Jake follows after her ]
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Well, if I'm like a child, then look, maybe you should teach me.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Sky People cannot learn, you do not See.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Then teach me how to See.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : No one can teach you to See.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Everything is backwards now, like out there is the true world, and in here is the dream. Helpful • 65 4
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You are Omaticaya now. You may make your bow from the wood of Hometree. And you may choose a woman. We have many fine women. Ninat is the best singer.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Yes, she is a good hunter. But I've already chosen. But this woman must also choose me.

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Well, uh, I guess this is my last video log. Because whatever happens tonight. Either way I'm... I'm not gonna be comin' back to this place. Well, I guess I better go. I don't wanna be late for my own party. It's my birthday, after all. This is Jake Sully signin' off.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to Tsu'tey ] With your permission, I will speak now. You would honor me by translating.
[ to the assembled Na'vi as Tsu'tey translates in Na'vi ]

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : The Sky People have sent us a message... that they can take whatever they want. That no one can stop them. Well, we will send them a message. You ride out as fast as the wind can carry you. You tell the other clans to come. Tell them Toruk Macto calls to them! You fly now, with me! My brothers! Sisters! And we will show the Sky People... that they cannot take whatever they want! And that this... this is our land!
[Moat](/name/nm0001634/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : It is hard to fill a cup that is already full.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : My cup is empty. Trust me. Just ask Dr. Augustine. I'm no scientist.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I was a marine. A warrior... of the uh... Jarhead Clan.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : She said all energy is only borrowed, and one day you have to give it back. Helpful • 25 1

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Narrating ] Outcast. Betrayer. Alien. I was in the place the eye does not see. I needed their help. And they needed mine. But to ever face them again, I was gonna have to take it to a whole new level. Helpful • 22 1
[ Grace and Jake spot a Hammerhead Titanothere ]
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Don't shoot! Don't shoot. You'll piss him off.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Jake, that armor's too thick. Trust me. It's a territorial threat display. Do not run or he'll charge.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : What do I do? Dance with it?
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Just hold your ground.
[ the Hammerhead Titanothere charges and Jake runs towards him and yells to scare him. The Titanothere runs away once seeing the Thanator ]

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Ha, ha! Yeah, come on! What you got! Oh yeah, who's bad? That's right. Yeah, that's what I'm talkin' about, bitch. That's right, get your punk ass back to mommy. Yeah? Yeah, you got nothin'. You keep runnin'. Why don't you bring some of your friends, huh?
[ Turns around and sees an angry Thanator standing in front of him ]
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to Grace ] What about this one? Run? Don't run? What?
[Mo'at](/name/nm0001634/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : It is decided. My daughter will teach you our ways. Learn well, "Jakesully", and we will see if your insanity can be cured. Helpful • 14 0

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Narrating ] The way I had it figured, Toruk's the baddest cat in the sky. Nothing attacks him. So why would he ever look up? That was just a theory. Helpful • 14 0

[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : So you just figured you'd come here, to the most hostile environment known to men, with no training of any kind, and see how it went? What was going through your head?
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Maybe I was sick of doctors telling me what I couldn't do.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : This is how it's done. When people are sittin' on shit that you want, you make 'em your enemy. Then you're justified in taking it. Helpful • 20 1
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Eywa has heard you... Eywa has heard you! Helpful • 13 0
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Narrating ] Sometimes your whole life boils down to one insane move. Helpful • 13 0
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ the instrumentation is going haywire, flying through clouds ] Looks like we're VFR from here on.
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : It means you gotta see where you're goin'.
[Norm Spellman](/name/nm0601376/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : But you can't see anything.
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ laughing ] Yeah, ain't that a bitch.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Now you choose your ikran. This you must feel inside. If he also chooses you, move quick like I showed. You will have one chance, Jake.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : How will I know if he chooses me?
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : He will try to kill you.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to his ikran on their first flight ] Shut up and fly straight! Helpful • 17 1
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ takes her hand, speaks hopefully ] Grace...?
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I'm with Her now, Jake. She is real...
[ Grace is showing pictures of the Na'vi to Jake so he remembers them ]
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Okay, let's run through them again.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Sees a picture ] Mo'at. Dragon lady.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Says the name correctly ] Ey-tu-"kahn". He's the clan leader. But she's the spiritual leader. Like a shaman.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Says the name correctly ] Tsu'tey.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : He'll be the next clan leader.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : She'll be the next "Tsahik". They become a mated pair.
[Norm Spellman](/name/nm0601376/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Who's Eywa? Only their deity! Their goddess, maker of all living things. Everything they know! You'd know this if you've had any training whatsoever.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Shows him Neytiri's picture ] Who's got a date with the chief's daughter?
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to Jake and Norm ] Knock it off you two. Village life starts early.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Don't do anything unusually stupid.
[ Jake grins as Grace rolls her eyes at him before closing the pod ]
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : What's goin' on, brother? Long time, no see.
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Personally, I don't feel these tree huggin' traitors deserve steak.
[Lock Up Trooper](/name/nm3712801/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : They get steak? That's bullshit. Let me see that.
[ Trudy laughs and then puts her gun to the back of the Lock Up Trooper's head as she orders him to the ground ]
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Yeah, you know what that is. Down, all the way down.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Yeah, right. It's the last one you'll ever see.
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ mortally wounded, realizing she's at the Tree of Souls ] I need to get some samples. Helpful • 11 0
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ after getting shot by Quaritch in the airship as they're flying away from the hangar ] This is gonna ruin my whole day! Helpful • 11 0
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ while flying with his ikran ] I may not be much of a horse guy, but I was born to do this. Helpful • 11 0
[Norm Spellman](/name/nm0601376/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : This is a very important part of it. It's not just, "I'm seeing you in front of me," it's "I see into you. I *See* you." Helpful • 11 0

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ as Jake pleads for Eywa's help in attacking the "Sky People" ] If Grace is there with you - look in her memories - she can show you the world we come from. There's no green there. They killed their Mother, and they're gonna do the same here. More Sky People are gonna come. They're gonna come like a rain that never ends. Unless we stop them. They chose me for something. I will stand and fight. You know I will. But I need a little help here.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Our great mother does not take sides, Jake; she protects the balance of life.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : It was worth a try.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ narrating ] There's no such thing as an ex-marine. You may be out, but you never lose the attitude. Helpful • 10 0
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I see you, Brother... thank you.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Your spirit will now be with Eywa, but your body will remain for The People.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : All I ever wanted was a single thing worth fighting for. Helpful • 10 0
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to Selfridge ] Those trees were sacred to the Omaticaya in a way you can't imagine.
[Selfridge](/name/nm0000610/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You know what? You throw a stick in the air around here it falls on some sacred fern, for Christ's sake!
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I'm not talking about pagan voodoo here - I'm talking about something REAL and measurable in the biology of the forest.

[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : What we think we know - is that there's some kind of electrochemical communication between the roots of the trees. Like the synapses between neurons. Each tree has ten to the fourth connections to the trees around it, and there are ten to the twelfth trees on Pandora...

[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : That's more connections than the human brain. You get it? It's a network - a global network. And the Na'vi can access it - they can upload and download data - memories - at sites like the one you just destroyed.
[Selfridge](/name/nm0000610/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ after a stunned pause ] What the HELL have you people been smoking out there?

[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You need to wake up, Parker. The wealth of this world isn't in the ground - it's all around us. The Na'vi know that, and they're fighting to defend it. If you wanna share this world with them, *you* need to understand *them*.
[Col. Quaritch](/name/nm0002332/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I think we understand them just fine. Thanks to Jake here.
[ Jake and Grace share a look of horror as Quaritch begins to play Jake's video log ]
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Just relax and let your mind go blank. That shouldn't be too hard for you.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Kiss the darkest part of my lily white...
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ in unfinished scene, DVD bonus material; about the Na'vi ] They didn't even have a word for 'lie'. Helpful • 10 0
[ Mo'at walks towards Jake and Grace with a knife ]
[Mo'at](/name/nm0001634/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ pleads with Jake ] If you are one of us, help us!
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : My grandfather's grandfather was Toruk Macto, Rider of Last Shadow.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Toruk chose him, it has only happened five times since the time of first songs.

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ speaking Na'vi ] Tsu'tey, son of Ateyo, I stand before you ready to serve the Omaticya people. You are Olo'eyctan, and you are a great warrior. I can't do this without you.
[Tsu'tey](/name/nm0022306/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Toruk Macto, I will fly with you.
[Neytiri](/name/nm0757855/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I'm with you now, Jake. We are mated for life.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to himself ] What the hell are you doin', Jake?

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I became a Marine for the hardship. Told myself that I can pass any test a man can pass. All I ever wanted was a single thing worth fighting for. Helpful • 8 0
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You're not the only one with a gun, bitch. Helpful • 8 0
[Mo'at](/name/nm0001634/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Why did you come to us?
[Mo'at](/name/nm0001634/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : We have tried to teach other Sky People, it is hard to fill a cup which is already full.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : My cup is empty, trust me. Just ask doctor Augustine, I'm no scientist.
[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I was a marine, a warrior of the uh, Jarhead clan.

[Col. Quaritch](/name/nm0002332/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : You are not in Kansas anymore. You are on Pandora, ladies and gentlemen. Respect that fact every second of every day. If there is a Hell, you might wanna go there for some R & R after a tour on Pandora. Out there beyond that fence every living thing that crawls, flies, or squats in the mud wants to kill you and eat your eyes for jujubes. We have an indigenous population of humanoids called the Na'vi. They're fond of arrows dipped in a neurotoxin that will stop your heart in one minute - and they have bones reinforced with naturally occurring carbon fiber. They are very hard to kill. As head of security, it is my job to keep you alive. I will not succeed. Not with all of you. If you wish to survive, you need to cultivate a strong, mental aptitude. You got to obey the rules: Pandora rules. Rule number one... Helpful • 16 2
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ sarcastically, after she opens fire on Quaritch's Dragon Gunship ] Oops. Helpful • 12 1
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ to the others on the airship while flying by the Hallelujah Mountains ] You should see your faces! Helpful • 7 0
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : Don't play with that. You'll go blind. Helpful • 7 0
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Trudy decides not to fire her missiles ] Screw this.
[Corporal Lyle Wainfleet](/name/nm0313902/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : What-what the hell are you doing?
[Trudy Chacon](/name/nm0735442/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : I didn't sign up for this shit!
[Dr. Grace Augustine](/name/nm0000244/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Emerging from her avatar pod ] Where's my goddamn cigarette? What's wrong with this picture! Helpful • 7 0

[Jake Sully](/name/nm0941777/?ref_=ttqu_qu) : [ Narrating ] When I was lying in the V.A. hospital with a big hole blown through the middle of my life, I started having these dreams of flying. I was free. But sooner or later, you always have to wake up.
